Title: School Paperwork Organization: Act, Save, Recycle
Description: Give every school paper one landing spot and three folders: ACT for permission slips and forms to sign, SAVE for school calendars and reference sheets, RECYCLE for expired notices. Kids drop papers in ACT after school, and an adult checks it after dinner and puts every deadline on the family calendar.
Keywords: school paperwork organization, school paper organization, permission slip organizer, school papers command center

Title: Family Command Center Ideas: Give Every Paper an Exit
Description: The part of a family command center most setups miss is the way out. Label two pockets Needs attention and Ready to go, check them after dinner, and move signed forms straight into the right backpack. All it takes is a calendar, two pockets and a pen in a spot your family already passes.
Keywords: family command center ideas, command center for school papers, home command center, paper organization station

Title: Holiday Family Planning Checklist: Give Every Job a Name
Description: Before the holiday rush, make four lists (dates, people, food and tasks) and write one name next to every job, including buying supplies and following through. The checklist shows how to hand off a whole job, like choosing, buying and bringing the drinks, and what to drop when plans change.
Keywords: holiday family planning checklist, holiday planning checklist, family holiday planning, holiday to do list
